title: Approval
description: Metadata for an approval. An approval is a review or approve process for a Drive item.

fileContentChangeBehavior.description: The behavior of the approval when the file content changes.

createTime.description: The time the approval was created.

modifyTime.description: The most recent time the approval was modified.

targetFileId.description: Target file id of the approval.

reviewerResponses.description: The responses made on the approval by reviewers.

dueTime.description: The time that the approval is due.

approvedRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the file when the approval completed successfully. This is only set when the approval status is APPROVED.

completeTime.description: The time the approval was completed.

status.description: The status of the approval at the time this resource was requested.
